text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.title: Better Mace Swap Config
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ge: Gear Up Clicks Per Tick (3 = 1 move)
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.au: Automatically swaps to your mace when you hit, then swaps back.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.sm: Picks Density while you are falling and Breach otherwise, instead of using the default mace mode.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.br: How many ticks to hold the mace before swapping back to your original slot.
Weapons: swap only when holding a weapon. All: swap with any item in hand.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.co: Combat features (Attribute Swap, Stun Slam, Trigger Bot, Auto Chestplate) work on players.
Combat features (Attribute Swap, Stun Slam, Trigger Bot, Auto Chestplate) work on mobs and animals.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ma: Which mace to prefer when not using Smart Switch: Density or Breach.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.at: All: swap no matter what you hold. Weapons Only: swap only when holding a weapon.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.au: Axe hit to stun, then a mace slam, automatically.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.st: Weapons: combo starts only when holding a weapon. All: starts with any item.
Return to the slot you started from after the slam.
Normal and Unsafe slam with no delay. Safe waits one tick before the slam.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.no: Ticks to wait before the axe swing when you have no mace.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.pe: Throws a wind charge to catch your own pearl.
Ticks to wait after the pearl is thrown before the catch.
Currently not used by the mod.
Turn your view to the return angle value after the pearl catch.
The pitch angle used when Return Angle is on.
Which item to switch to after the pearl catch.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ai: Smoothly pulls your aim toward the nearest valid target.
How fast Aim Assist turns toward the target.
Maximum distance in blocks at which Aim Assist locks onto a target.
Aim Assist can lock onto mobs and animals.
Aim Assist can lock onto players.
Which part of the target Aim Assist points at.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.tr: Attacks automatically when your crosshair is on a valid target, only while you are falling. Works without Aim Assist.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.au: Swaps your elytra for a chestplate when a target is 4 to 5 blocks away (picked at random), then back once it is far again. Uses the Aim Assist target settings.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ai: While Falling: Aim Assist works only when falling. Always: works all the time.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.lu: When you hit a block with a non-weapon in hand, swaps to your spear and then back.
Ticks to wait before the Lunge Swap.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.wi: Right-click while holding a sword, axe or mace to fire a wind charge from your hotbar.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ro: Allows firework rockets to be used with the right-click boost, along with or instead of a wind charge.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.au: Jumps and throws a wind charge automatically when looking down on the ground.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.el: Lets you arm an Elytra Boost with its keybind.
Pitch angle your view is redirected to during the Elytra Boost.
Ticks to wait before the Elytra Boost redirect.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.sh: Shows status messages above the hotbar (toggles, Gear Up, record).
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ge: Inventory clicks per tick during Gear Up. 3 clicks make 1 move.
Ticks to wait between Gear Up click batches. 0 means no delay.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ai: Throws a wind charge after you throw a splash potion while in the air.
text.autoconfig.bettermaceswap.option.ex: Experimental pearl catch that simulates the pearl flight to time the catch.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.bettermac: Mace PvP practice tool: Attribute Swap, Stun Slam, Pearl Catch, Aim Assist, Gear Up kits and more. Configure everything in this menu or with /bms.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.bettermaceswa: Mace PvP practice tool with swaps, combos and aim assist.
